saw_lines: 3D print buyers want proof that a file will print cleanly on their own machine before they pay for it.
So a buyer who sees no reason to trust the file or the price scrolls past, and the sale is lost.
Your 1 live Meta ad shows no proof number. Lead the next batch with one, such as your review count or orders shipped, printed on the creative.
ads_1: Review count and first-order offer lead each 3D model ad
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
